name: Baba Is AI
description: Humans solve problems by following existing rules and procedures, and also by leaps of creativity to redefine those rules and objectives. To probe these abilities, we developed a new benchmark based on the game Baba Is You where an agent manipulates both objects in the environment and rules, represented by movable tiles with words written on them, to reach a specified goal and win the game. We test three state-of-the-art multi-modal large language models (OpenAI GPT-4o, Google Gemini-1.5-Pro and Gemini-1.5-Flash) and find that they fail dramatically when generalization requires that the rules of the game must be manipulated and combined.
reputation: New and notable in the research community for probing rule-manipulation and compositional generalization in multimodal LLMs, but still early in adoption.
notes: Environment-based, multimodal benchmark — evaluation depends on simulator setup. Small / specialized task set and potential exposure of simple game rules in pretraining could confound results.
